id./param/scenario/cs/a_110_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Huh? Hey, {var:1}. The branch...
"Hey! What was that?! I saw it too!
"An altar standing in the heavens... and six orbs too.
"Sister! Could it mean that if we offer six orbs to that altar, the road to Yggdrasil will open?!
"Wow... Now we know how to reach the Great Tree. That's the Rainbough's power. It was worth searching so long.
"Those orbs we just saw are like this one, right? This thing I stole from Heliodor Castle had such meaning.
"I had my own use for it, but if that's the story, you can have it. Take good care of it.
{var:1} received the Red Orb!
"Master Rab, it was right not to sell it. The orb you got at the Masked Tourney.
"Indeed. We nearly turned it into travel money without knowing its true worth. Here, {var:1}. Take it.
{var:1} received the Yellow Orb!
"The altar's place is directly beneath Yggdrasil. Probably the hidden land called the First Forest.
"{var:1}, our path is set. Collect the remaining four orbs and offer them at the altar in the First Forest.
"Four orbs left... But where do we even begin to look?
"Speaking of orbs, I heard as a child that there's one sunk at the bottom of the sea, but that sounds like a wild goose chase...
"Anyway, we have no leads now. Looks like we have to search the whole world for information.
"Yes. To cover the whole world, we should first pass through the floodgate in Puerto Valor and go out to the open sea.
"Puerto Valor can be reached by ship, sailing northwest from Gondolia.
"Luckily, Puerto Valor has a lord I know named Jasper. If I ask him, he should gladly open the floodgate.
"All right! Let's set out to find the orbs! To defeat Mordegon, we gather six orbs and open the road to Yggdrasil!
